messages.subject: Calverton v Ferncliffe - Advice on merits and quantum
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Tom,

My advice is attached. In short: strong on liability for the affected heats; the real risk is quantum, especially the Wexbourne loss of profit and the limitation clause at clause 11. I have assessed overall prospects at better than 65% and put a risk-adjusted value of roughly 1.0-1.4m against the pleaded sum. I recommend a Part 35 metallurgy report addressing causation and an openness to mediation once that is in.

Happy to discuss.

Harriet Stanford
Eldon Chambers

messages.subject: Counsel's advice - headline points
messages.plaintextBody:
Patricia,

Harriet Stanford's advice is in (attached). Headlines: liability strong on the bad heats; main risks are the Wexbourne loss-of-profit head and Ferncliffe's limitation clause, which she thinks is arguable both ways. Risk-adjusted value around 1.0-1.4m. She recommends a Part 35 metallurgy report on causation and staying open to mediation.

Given this, I suggest we issue and serve, instruct Dr Iqbal formally, and propose mediation in parallel. Andrew - this fits your wish to keep momentum while controlling cost.

Tom Gallagher
Associate, Dispute Resolution
